facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: 6-month equity-free program, mentorship, legal support, subsidized perks and funding connections; no standard check
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Academic biotech / life-science project; local chapter or Global Virtual Activator
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: PI approval; well-defined technology/product backed by preliminary scientific research; existing IP or clear path to file within a year; commercialization potential; team intends to spin out.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site Required: Local chapters in-person; Global Virtual available
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: ~5–10 hours/week; six months; location depends on chapter.
facts_raw.International Founder: Yes via global chapters / Global Virtual
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Status: Program active; current official Activator page still displays older cohort date details
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: Chapter-specific; verify local chapter before applying
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Verification: Official current program model; cohort dates chapter-specific
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；阶段以 Pre-company–early 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
